metricLinesTitle.message: Show the bars and shares as line counts

metricBytesTitle.message: Show the bars and shares as file sizes

Fetches the file listing, then the line count of every file in the ticked rows
(one API request per file)

Fetches the line counts of $1 files from GitHub

lede.message: Visualises line counts on GitHub's file list, so bloated files stand out.

tokensHint1.message: Without one, public repositories work at 60 requests an hour. A token raises that to 5,000 and reaches private repositories. With several accounts, add one per owner — a token cannot read another account's private repositories.

tokensHint3.message: — it needs only Contents: Read-only. Tokens stay in this machine's chrome.storage.local and go nowhere but api.github.com.

tokenDefaultTitle.message: The token to use when no owner matches

tokenOwners.message: Owners this token is for (comma separated)

tokenVerify.message: Verify and fill in the owners

thresholdsHint.message: A file past these line counts is coloured as a warning.

showBars.message: Show proportion bars on the file list

modeAuto.message: Automatic — fetch as soon as the page opens

modeManual.message: Manual — fetch nothing on open. Pick lines or size on the strip above the list and press the button; the row checkboxes narrow what it fetches

modeOff.message: Off — estimates only, one API request per view

modeHint.message: In every mode, files counted before show their real value from the cache, without an API request.

cacheHint.message: Counts are cached under the file's blob SHA. A git blob SHA is a hash of the content, so a file whose content has not changed is never fetched again, whatever the branch or commit.

excludeGenerated.message: Exclude files matching the patterns below

patternsHint.message: Binaries (images, fonts, archives and the like) are recognised by extension and always excluded.

ownersFound.description: $1 is a list of owner names

ownersMore.description: $1 is a list of names, $2 how many are not shown

ownersNone.message: could not work out which owners it reaches — fill them in yourself

verifyOk.message: valid as $1 — $2 ($3/$4 requests left this hour)$5
verifyOk.description: $1 login, $2 what it reaches, $3/$4 requests left, $5 a note about its kind

lang.description: The BCP 47 tag for this catalogue, for the options page's lang attribute
